Create a CLEARLY VISIBLE but calm tactical chibi game IDLE BREATHING AND WEIGHT-SHIFT sprite animation of this exact character, 검사. Preserve the exact original character identity, SD proportions, face, hair colors, costume, weapon, and clean anime rendering.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the current 4-column, 3-row sprite sheet to edit. Keep its design and layout. Image 2 is the original identity/pose reference with FRONT, BACK, RIGHT SIDE left-to-right.
OUTPUT: one RGBA transparent sprite sheet with exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Ideally 1536x1152. Row 1 FRONT, row 2 BACK (no face visible), row 3 RIGHT SIDE (face right). Scale these displacements proportionally to the larger drawn figures. Add a small 2-3px sideways torso weight shift at the peak, and a 5-8px gentle sway of hair tips, cape/coattails or loose cloth. Give hair/cloth a slight delayed follow-through. Keep the head shape and size constant: it follows the neck naturally, never enlarges or changes expression.
GROUND LOCK: BOTH boot soles stay planted on exactly the SAME ground pixels in every column of a row. Ankles/shins are stable, no walking or sliding. The movement is articulated through hips, spine, shoulders, neck, sleeves, and loose hair/cloth. Do NOT simply move the whole figure up and down. Keep the weapon in its resting hold with only a small natural follow-through, no attack/aim/cast. Sword stays in his RIGHT hand, cobalt shoulder drape stays on his LEFT. Keep the sword lowered in the resting hold.
All figures have the same overall scale and fixed cell registration, feet near 90% cell height, generous clear transparent cell margins, no cropped weapons or hair. Make the peak pose noticeably different from the neutral pose while remaining a combat-ready idle. The game returns through columns 2 and 1 to column 0 so the loop stays smooth.

initial_intermediates.prompt:
Edit the supplied reference into a production sprite sheet for a VERY SUBTLE IDLE BREATHING LOOP of this EXACT same original chibi tactical-RPG character (검사).
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE: identity/pose reference. It contains three existing idle views, left to right FRONT, BACK, RIGHT SIDE. Preserve their exact character design, SD body/head proportions, face, hair shape and colors, costume, weapon, handedness, and facing. The back view must remain fully back-facing with no face or eyes. The side view must face RIGHT.
OUTPUT: one transparent RGBA sprite sheet, ideally 1536 x 1152, exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, twelve full-body figures. Row 1 FRONT, row 2 BACK, row 3 RIGHT SIDE. No other characters. No titles, labels, numbers, grid lines, panels, ground, shadows, checkerboard, or effects.
IDLE PHASES in each row, left to right: 0 neutral/resting; 1 one-third of a quiet breath in; 2 two-thirds of the same breath; 3 the soft peak of that breath. The game plays 0-1-2-3-2-1 then repeats. These are NOT attack frames. All four poses must be almost identical; at the final game size the shoulders/upper torso rise only about 2-3 pixels and hair/cloth tips shift only 1-2 pixels. Eyes stay open with the same calm expression. Keep both soles planted, legs unchanged, no body translation, stepping, turning, jumping, swinging a weapon, exaggerated stretching, or arm gestures. Weapons remain in the same resting grip and angle. Sword stays in his RIGHT hand, cobalt shoulder drape stays on his LEFT. Keep the sword lowered in the resting hold.
REGISTRATION: in every equal cell keep identical character scale and facing. Feet centered horizontally at the same baseline near 90% of the cell height, whole figure safely inside the cell with generous transparent margins. Only tiny breathing motion above the hips plus faint hair/cloth follow-through. Match the reference's clean anime linework and restrained shading exactly. Keep transparent pixels truly alpha-transparent.
